div.head: Af 42.5
div.ab: Eac we cweðaþ, þæt mon mote mid his hlaforde feohtan orwige, gif mon on þone hlaford fiohte; swa mot se hlaford mid þam men feohtan.
Eac we cweðað, þæt mon mote mid his hlaforde feohtan orwige, gif mon on ðone hlaford fiohte; swa mót se hlaford mid þy men feohtan.
Item diximus, ut homini liceat pugnare cum domino suo sine wita, si quis assalliat ipsum dominum. Sic liceat domino pugnare cum homine suo.
Eac we cweðað, þæt mon mote mid his hlaforde feohtan orwige, gif mon on ðone hlaford fiohte; swa mót se hlaford mid þy men feohtan.
Likewise we declare, that one may fight at the side of his lord without incurring liability if someone fights against his lord; the lord may similarly fight at the side of [his] man.
We further declare that a man may fight on behalf of his lord, if his lord is attacked, without becoming liable to vendetta. Under similar conditions a lord may fight on behalf of his men.
Moreover we declare that a man may fight on behalf of his lord, if the lord is being attacked, without incurring a vendetta. Similarly the lord may fight on behalf of his man.
Auch bestimmen wir, dass man bei seinem Herrn fechten darf, ohne Fehde [auf sich zu laden], vorausgesetzt, dass jemand gegen diesen Herrn ficht; ebenso darf der Herr bei dem Manne fechten.
We also determine that one may fight on behalf of one’s lord without [incurring] feud, provided that someone is fighting against that lord; likewise the lord may fight on behalf of his man.
